allowed_population: Only native triplets conservatively eligible in hls_native_triplets_v1.json; no T9-associated family or unclassified family
correspondence_partition: Metadata-only 8 family-pair holdout, 32 fitting pairs; no held-out pair in global transfer fitting; same families can occur in both, so this tests unseen pairs not unseen families

alignment.cross_correlation: zero-mean normalized waveform cross-correlation; reference candidate segments remain within original recording; no circular wrap
alignment.joint_choice: minimum calibration residual over at most 25 independent heart/lung lag pairs, each with two diagnostic least-squares gains
alignment.temporal_holdout: common valid support outside calibration interval; do not refit gains/lags there
alignment.drift_probe: three chronological common-support segments; subtract other aligned/gain-scaled source, re-estimate each source lag within +/-0.25 seconds of fixed lag; descriptive, never a DTW target transform

waveform_global_transfer.fit_population: correspondence fitting pairs and calibration time 6-9s only; equal family-pair weight, then equal recording weight
waveform_global_transfer.form: one joint two-input complex spectral least-squares transfer, converted to two fixed 257-tap centered FIR filters
waveform_global_transfer.fit_scaling: divide all three signals by the same per-triplet mixture RMS; no independent source normalization
waveform_global_transfer.heldout_use: apply fixed filters to per-record reference-aligned waveforms; no heldout filter or post-filter gain fit
waveform_global_transfer.interpretation: reference-assisted offline correspondence diagnostic, not separator performance

spectral_global_transfer.form: nonnegative regularized two-source PSD mapping per frequency, smoothed globally; no per-record filter
spectral_global_transfer.fit_scaling: divide all PSDs by same per-triplet mixture variance
spectral_global_transfer.comparison: heldout fixed global mapping versus uncorrected sum; magnitude/power diagnostic does not establish waveform phase targets

fingerprint.population: eligible native reference versus same-source-class 86-row non-test standalone allowlist only
fingerprint.waveform_comparison: bounded lagged normalized correlation; native reference center 6-9s versus each standalone source, abs lag<=4s
fingerprint.spectral_descriptor: normalized Welch PSD and band-energy distances; similar family spectra are not proof of exact waveform reuse

quality_policy: Tiering and one training role will be decided from correspondence evidence before any neural treatment; no model-score-based triplet exclusions
waveform_label_error_tolerance: Role A requires residual RMS <= 0.10 times weaker corrected source RMS on untouched temporal support, stable identifiable alignment, >=8s valid support and unseen-pair global correction; this engineering tolerance is not statistical significance
counterfactual_policy: Deterministic seed-20260928 wrong-family/same-site preferred and same-family alternate references; identical diagnostic flexibility; never select mismatches by signal scores
